services.name: Sail Venice
services.desc: Check the local weather forecast temperatures by the hour during the time of your charter. It is generally a few degrees cooler on the water. North Winds are cooler than South. During transitional times sunset and morning sails the temp will vary more. Everything will stay dry, so better to have extra clothing choices

variants.label: Sailing trip with drinks and light snacks, wildlife sightings including manatees and dolphins

blurb: Guests sail on the Gulf of Mexico with experienced sailors Captain Dove and Tim. Trips include wildlife sightings such as manatees and dolphins, and provide drinks and light snacks. The boat has a Bimini for shade, a comfortable cabin with a marine restroom, and safety instructions are given before departure.
extraNote: Annual haulout from July 14 to October 15, if no hurricanes · Crow’s Nest Marina on Venice Island, directly in front of the restaurant just before the South Jetty · Annual haulout from July 14 to October 15, weather permitting
highlights: Wildlife sightings including manatees and dolphins

You may bring your own cooler or adult beverages

quotes.author: Wayne W
quotes.text: Sail Venice was a terrific experience. My wife and I celebrated our 16th Wedding Aniv. with Capt Dove and Crew. We felt totally pampered and relaxed as we enjoyed libations and a beautiful sunset. While out, we saw 6 manatees and some dolphin jumping. Totally made our day. I was pleasantly surprised at the great price too. We can’t wait to book again.

quotes.author: lwilson2247
quotes.text: Capt. Dove & Tim really showed us a great time. It couldn’t have been anymore perfect. Will definitely be back with family/friends when we move down next year. Don’t hesitate booking – you will have a great time!
